James Lincoln Collier was born on June 27, 1928. He is a member of Hamilton College’s class of 1950 where he was a member of the Fallacious Five, a student run traditional jazz band. Mr. Collier is a noted writer of jazz and children’s books and continues to play his trombone in the New York City area.
He was interviewed in New York City on January 14, 2007 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Manhattan filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m really pleased to have James Lincoln Collier with me today, author, trombonist and Hamilton class of 1950.
Yeah well I’m very happy to be here.
I was reading some things about you and it sort of looks like you can trace your writing genes all the way back to the Plymouth Colony.
How did you find that out?
There’s a lot of stuff floating around.
